metadata.description: Stylish HUD mods for the Claude Code terminal: limit rings, animated progress bars and highlighted replies

plugins.name: limit-bars
plugins.description: Four animated braille rings under the prompt: context, session, weekly and Fable limits, plus model and folder

plugins.name: plan-progress-fx
plugins.description: Animated rainbow plan progress bars under the prompt, beside the limit rings

plugins.name: reply-highlight
plugins.description: Sets Claude's replies apart in the transcript: a rainbow edge, a violet tint, and bold text and headings in a rainbow
